messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "intensive care setting"
set: ["intensive care setting", "coronary care unit or similar setting", "stress ulcer bleeding prophylaxis in critical care setting", "MRI setting", "peptic ulcer rebleeding prophylaxis after hemostasis in critical care setting", "special medical care", "not likely to miss dose in medical setting", "needs care in people with breathing problems", "seek immediate medical care if signs observed", "digoxin needs care for two separate reasons", "use extra care while shaving or brushing teeth", "include diet, exercise, weight control, and special medical care", "seek immediate medical care if you notice these signs", "must use in setting where you can detect and respond to alarms", "use extra care to prevent bleeding while shaving or brushing teeth", "talk to care team before starting if any of these apply to you"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
